A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the kinematic hardening model with ten history variables and the isotropic hardning model are both able to give a good prediction of the U bend springback.
the kinematic hardening model is the one that gives the most promising results.
the kinematic hardening models are the ones that should be considered for accurate springback prediction in sheet forming.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a hardening law that is able to capture some of the transient effects during bending is needed for accurate springback prediction.
it is possible to achieve a very good accuracy in the springback prediction with a hardening law that involves a moderate complexity.
a simple hardening law, such as the isotropic hardning one, is sufficient for an accurate spring back prediction.
